content: हर्म्यम् [हृ-यत् मुट् च] .²1 A palace, mansion, any large or palatial building; हर्म्यपृष्ठं समारूढः काकोऽपि गरुडायते <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls>; वाह्योद्यानस्थितहरशिर श्चन्द्रिकाधौतहर्म्या <ls>Me. 7</ls>; <ls>Ṛs. 1. 28</ls>; <ls>Bk. 8. 36</ls>; <ls>R. 6. 47</ls>; <ls>Ku. 6. 42</ls>. .²2 An oven, a fire-place, hearth. .²3 A fiery pit, abode of evil spirits, the infernal regions.
